decisions.reason: The client expands the direction materials for storyboard deviations from detailed shot descriptions alone to detailed descriptions with optional online example frames.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Updating the storyboard reel on my side is also an option but I’m just bit good at it yet and it takes too long for me so I’d like to try with more detailed shot descriptions and maybe example frames I pull from online.

decisions.reason: The new direction-reference process does not change the accepted angle adjustments or regeneration options for improving set-image quality.
The online example frames concern communicating storyboard deviations, not the separate character-detail and artistic-style references established for character rendering.
Changing how deviations are communicated does not alter the established CC1 shot pairs or framing progression.
The direction-reference process neither changes the requested aerial shot nor resumes it from its deferred status.
